papers.title: Wage packet, 1911
lines: Sixteen shillings, less the fine for talking at the loom, one and tuppence.
Overheard at the gate: 'If they fined us for what we thought, they'd owe us money.'

papers.title: Match programme
lines: Saturday, three o'clock. Admission sixpence, tea a penny, hope free.
Someone has written on it in pencil: 'Dad took me. We lost. Best day of the year.'

trail.clue: A boy's lucky halfpenny is buried near the big rock. He marked the spot on the back of a ticket.

papers.title: Shopping list
lines: Two pounds of potatoes. A tin of peas. Black pudding if it looks honest.
Something for the cat that is not the black pudding.
Bus fare. Do not tell our Brenda about the bus fare.

papers.title: Telegram
lines: PRICES UP STOP SHIPMENT DELAYED AT LIVERPOOL STOP DO NOT PANIC STOP
PANIC ONLY IF I TELEGRAM AGAIN STOP
